7

9	multi-package React design system (`@gravity-ui/*`), so the two things that go
10	wrong are picking the wrong package and using an API from the wrong version.
11	This skill routes you to the right package, grounds you in the installed
12	version, and stops you from inventing APIs — match the installed versions and
13	follow the ecosystem catalog instead of guessing.
14

17	- Do not read the same file twice. Reuse evidence already present in the session.
18	- Do not dump a reference file wholesale. Use targeted `rg -n -C 4` searches and keep each result below
19	  200 lines unless the whole file is necessary to resolve the task.

25	  unless the user explicitly requests visual or browser verification.

27	  the check. Do not repeatedly rebuild unchanged code.

32	needs. Do not guess from training data — the ecosystem has look-alike packages
33	(`charts` vs `chartkit`, uikit `Table` vs `@gravity-ui/table`, `date-components`
34	vs `date-utils`, …) and picking the wrong one is the #1 failure.
35	Choose from the task's functionality, not only from dependencies already present in the project.
36

38	long and its decisive entries sit near the end — agents that skim its top pick `uikit` for everything.

49	| The app shell: aside navigation, header, footer | `@gravity-ui/navigation` (`AsideHeader`) | a hand-rolled `<aside>` |
50	| Interface language switching | uikit `configure({lang})` + `@gravity-ui/i18n` for app strings | `i18next`, `react-intl` |

54	its documented peer deps) — the fixture having only `uikit` is not a reason to build the thing by hand.
55	
56	Open [`references/package-routing.md`](references/package-routing.md) and read
57	its top: it is the ecosystem catalog, with the live-vs-offline source order,
58	the "painful pairs" disambiguation, and a one-line "what it's for / what to use
59	instead" per package. Use it to choose the package, then come back here for
60	Step 1.
61	
62	Search the catalog for the task's relevant terms and read the matching package entries. Do not read the
63	entire catalog when its top and those entries are sufficient.
64	
65	Only after the package is chosen, run Step 1 to ground in that package's
66	installed version and API.

71	   version. The installed version is the source of truth, not your memory.
72	   Resolve ranges from `node_modules` (`<pkg>/package.json` `version` field), not
73	   the range string in the root `package.json`.
74

76	   existing package manager before importing it. Install its documented peer dependencies too, then
77	   resolve the installed version and continue with the local evidence below. Do not fall back to uikit,
78	   raw HTML, or a foreign library merely because the specialized package was initially absent. If
79	   installation is blocked, report the exact failure.

82	   stopping at the first source that answers your question:**
83

87	      If an import, component, hook, or prop remains uncertain, inspect only its exact installed `.d.ts`
88	      before moving online. Batch all uncertain symbol lookups for that package.
89	   (b) **ONLINE** — per-package llms.txt at the **major line**:
90	      `https://gravity-ui.com/llms/<pkg>/<major>/llms.txt`
91	      (e.g. `/llms/uikit/7/llms.txt` for `^7.2.1`). The major-line URL serves the
92	      latest minor of that major — it tracks the major but not the exact patch.
93	      Use it when LOCAL has no docs for the package.

98	     → fetch the ONLINE major-line llms.txt (b).
99	   - If the ONLINE request fails — network timeout, DNS, connection refused
100	     (air-gapped / corporate proxy), HTTP 404 (major not hosted), or an empty /
101	     non-markdown body → fall back to LOCAL README + dist/docs or build/docs (a).
102	   - **Do NOT use the `/llms/<pkg>/llms.txt` "latest" alias** as a fallback — it
103	     serves the newest major, which may differ from the installed one and have a
104	     different API. The major-line URL is the versioned fallback; below it, go
105	     LOCAL, not "latest".
106	   - If BOTH are unreachable for a package → STOP and tell the user the
107	     package's docs are unreachable. Do not guess its API from training data.
108	
109	For a bounded local inspection, run:
110	
111	```sh
112	.agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit Button Card Switch ThemeProvider
113	```
114	
115	The script reports the resolved version, available local documentation, and declaration files matching
116	the requested symbols. Read only the returned files needed to confirm an uncertain API.
117	
118	## Step 2 — implement on the chosen packages, then typecheck
119	
120	1. **Implement using only the `@gravity-ui/*` packages chosen in Step 0 and
121	   confirmed installed in Step 1.** Import from those packages exactly — do
122	   not substitute look-alike libraries (MUI, Ant, plain `<input>`) and do not
123	   reach for a `@gravity-ui/*` package that Step 1 did not confirm installed.
124	   Follow the prop APIs from the docs you just read, not memory; if a prop
125	   you want is not documented, it does not exist — use the documented one, or
126	   ask the user.
127	
128	2. **Apply the cross-cutting rules** in `rules/hallucination-traps.md` while
129	   writing: typography variants, the flex contract, theming/ladders,
130	   `Button view`, `Icon data`. Per-component traps live in the package's own
131	   `dist/docs`.
132	
133	3. **Typecheck before declaring done.** Run the project's typecheck command
134	   (typically `tsc --noEmit`; for monorepos, the workspace's typecheck script).
135	   Fix every error before reporting completion — a type error almost always
136	   means a wrong/invented prop, a wrong import path, or a version mismatch,
137	   which is precisely what Steps 0–1 were meant to prevent.
138	
139	   - If the typecheck surfaces a prop/path that contradicts the docs you read
140	     in Step 1, trust the **installed version** (the typechecker), not the
141	     docs snapshot — the docs may be from a different minor. Re-ground: read
142	     the package's `dist/docs/INDEX.md` in `node_modules` for the exact
143	     installed types.
144	   - If the typecheck is unavailable (no TS in the project), say so
145	     explicitly and ask the user how they want to verify; do not silently
146	     skip verification.
147	   - **Escape hatch.** If the user explicitly waived verification ("just
148	     sketch it", "quick prototype", "no need to check"), you may skip the
149	     typecheck — but state this plainly in your reply: *"typecheck skipped by
150	     user request — code is not verified"*. Do not skip silently.
151	
152	## Hard rules
153	
154	- **`@gravity-ui/uikit` MUST be installed in every Gravity UI project.** It is
155	  the base component + design-token library every other `@gravity-ui/*` package
156	  builds on; without it components render unstyled. If `package.json` lacks it,
157	  stop and have the user install and configure it first (setup:
158	  `https://gravity-ui.com/llms/uikit/llms.txt`).
159	- **Read `package.json` before importing any `@gravity-ui/*` package.** Never
160	  assume a package is installed; never assume its major version.
161	- **Do not invent props or components.** Before using a component API you are
162	  not 100% sure of, check `rules/hallucination-traps.md` (ecosystem patterns)
163	  and the component's README in `dist/docs`. If still unsure, ask the user
164	  rather than guessing.
165	- **Never guess icon names** — they are hallucinated more often than not. To
166	  match an icon from a screenshot/photo/mock, run `scripts/icon-image-search.sh`
167	  (reverse image search). With only a description, look the name up on
168	  `gravity-ui.com/icons` or ask the user — do not invent one. Then pass it as an
169	  object (`<Icon data={CheckIcon} />`), never a string key. See
170	  `references/icons.md`.
171	- **Theming uses semantic `--g-*` tokens.** Never hardcode colors (`#fff`,
172	  `blue-500`); never hand-write `dark:` overrides. Full token tables live in
173	  `references/theming.md`; the cross-cutting traps (partial brand overrides,
174	  scoped vs nested `ThemeProvider`, controls on a brand background) live in
175	  `rules/hallucination-traps.md`.
176	- **Required setup is package-specific** (style imports, `ThemeProvider`,
177	  peer-deps). It lives in each package's root README under "Required setup" —
178	  read it once per package, do not rely on memory.
179	
180	## What NOT to do
181	
182	These are the five most common ways agents break Gravity UI code. They are
183	already implied by the rules above; this section exists as an explicit
184	stop-sign. If you are about to do any of these, stop and re-ground.
185	
186	- **Do not substitute non-Gravity libraries.** No MUI, Ant Design, plain
187	  `<input>`/`<button>`, or look-alike component libs. Use the `@gravity-ui/*`
188	  package the task needs.
189	- **Do not invent component APIs or props.** If a prop is not in the docs you
190	  read in Step 1, it does not exist — do not write `variant=`, `color=`,
191	  `name=` (on `Icon`), or a `header-3` variant. Use the documented prop or
192	  ask the user. See `rules/hallucination-traps.md`.
193	- **Do not use the `/llms/<pkg>/llms.txt` "latest" alias as a fallback.** It
194	  serves the newest major, which may differ from the installed one and have a
195	  different API. The versioned online fallback is the major-line URL
196	  (`/llms/<pkg>/<major>/llms.txt`); below that, go LOCAL.
197	- **Do not partial-brand.** Setting only `--g-color-base-brand` leaves
198	  selection, focus, links and contrast on the default accent — a mismatched
199	  UI. Override the full brand token set, on each theme you support.
200	- **Do not override internal markup with `[class*='…']` / ID selectors.**
201	  That's written against one DOM structure and breaks silently when the
202	  component changes. Climb the customization ladder
203	  (global token → component CSS API → narrow flagged hack) before ever
204	  touching structure.
205	
206	## Deeper material — read on demand
207	
208	These files live alongside this SKILL.md and load only when relevant:
209	
210	- `references/package-routing.md` — offline snapshot of the ecosystem catalog
211	  (`gravity-ui.com/llms.txt`), refreshed each skill release. Used as the
212	  offline fallback in Step 0.
213	- `references/theming.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/theming.md`:
214	  `--g-*` token layers, `ThemeProvider`, branding, custom themes, scoped
215	  themes, `uikit-themer`. The bundled copy may lag — read
216	  `node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs/guides/theming.md` for the
217	  version-matched file.
218	- `references/layout.md` — verbatim copy of uikit's `docs/layout.md`:
219	  spacing scale (`--g-spacing-*`), `Flex`/`Box`, `Row`/`Col`/`Container`
220	  grid, breakpoints, `useLayoutContext`.
221	- `references/icons.md` — finding an icon by image
222	  (`scripts/icon-image-search.sh`) or on gravity-ui.com/icons; the
223	  object-vs-string rendering rule.
224	- `rules/hallucination-traps.md` — Incorrect/Correct pairs for the most
225	  commonly invented APIs: typography variants (`header-3..6` don't exist, no
226	  `Heading`), the flex contract (`min-width:0`, who shrinks), theming traps
227	  (partial brand overrides, scoped vs nested `ThemeProvider`, customization
228	  ladder), `Button view` not `variant`, `Icon data` not `name`. Per-component
229	  traps live in each package's `dist/docs`, not here.
